LanguageData.MJV_SettingsAllowRecruitmentDesc: Converts may be called to serve the Empire and leave with the justiciar's shuttle. Disabling this prevents new calls, including in ongoing missions. Colonists already called to service are unaffected.
LanguageData.MJV_SettingsImperialMissionsDesc: Allow quests to host an imperial justiciar for sermons, including both equipment rewards and blueprint commissions.
LanguageData.MJV_SettingsDisgracedSermonDesc: Allow quests to shelter a disgraced justiciar and defend against the pursuing faction.
LanguageData.MJV_SettingsQuestChanges: Quest switches apply to new offers. Existing quests can still be accepted and completed. All options are enabled by default.
LanguageData.MJV_MissionRecruitmentWarning: It is said that, now and then, a new believer follows a justiciar back to the Empire.
